name: normalize_naturality
statement: NormalMonoidalObject C) {X Y : F C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : inclusionObj n ◁ f ≫ (normalizeIsoApp' C Y n).hom = (normalizeIsoApp' C X n).hom ≫ inclusion.map (eqToHom (Discrete.ext (normalizeObj_congr n f)))

have_tree.body: dcongr_arg (fun x => (normalizeIsoApp' C η' x).hom) (normalizeObj_congr n h)
